value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor looks hot and humid, high 29, feeling like 35 with the humidex (Environment Canada, from this afternoon). Early on there's a 30% chance of showers and a risk of a thunderstorm, but it should clear in the morning. It'll be gusty too: southwest wind 20 km/h gusting to 50, picking up to 40 gusting to 60 late in the morning.
